release_claim.reason: All five functional-validation findings have source repairs and focused regression evidence; acceptance remains withheld until an independent exact-artifact verification pass.

findings.finding: Nested Agent and Workflow workers discard the configured Studio key root
findings.root_cause: The inner ProcessSupervisor environments were independently reconstructed and omitted the host authority-store locators inherited by the durable session worker.
findings.repair: Agent and Workflow inner workers now forward only PX_STUDIO_KEY_ROOT, XDG_STATE_HOME, and LOCALAPPDATA; keys, approval secrets, and unrelated environment values remain excluded.

findings.finding: Valid silent Workflow nodes are killed after two seconds
findings.root_cause: Workflow business output was incorrectly used as process-start liveness and idle timeout was capped at two seconds.
findings.repair: The worker emits a structured flushed startup acknowledgement, while silent business work receives the declared node timeout as its idle and total bound.

findings.finding: The Studio approval broker remains self-issuable by an untrusted CLI caller
findings.root_cause: The project-callable approval CLI accepted caller-authored approver identity without an independent host-session credential.
findings.repair: Caller-controlled approved_by was removed. Issuance requires a VS Code SecretStorage-backed enrolled broker secret and uses a fixed host-derived identity; ordinary direct CLI issuance and wrong-secret issuance fail closed.

findings.finding: Process-supervision receipts report negative dropped bytes
findings.root_cause: Dropped bytes were calculated against remaining capacity rather than the number of bytes actually appended.
findings.repair: Capture now counts len(chunk)-actual_appended and derives truncation only from a positive dropped-byte count.

findings.root_cause: Header, token, control, and accessibility selectors still had simultaneous modular and legacy compatibility owners.
findings.repair: Those selectors were migrated to their modular owners, cross-file duplication is now zero and enforced, and the total ceilings were ratcheted from 177/224 to 167/208.
